functions.name: getNewMail
functions.description: Trigger a check for new mail. If accountId is omitted, checks all authenticated accounts via Thunderbird's cmd_getMsgsForAuthAccounts. If provided, checks that one account by calling getNewMessages on its incoming server.

parameters.name: accountId
parameters.description: WebExtension account ID. Omit for all accounts.

functions.name: openSettings
functions.description: Open Thunderbird's Settings (about:preferences) in a tab in the main window.

parameters.name: accountId
parameters.description: WebExtension account ID to focus. Omit for first account.

functions.name: getUIFontSize
functions.description: Return Thunderbird's UI font size in CSS pixels: the user's explicit setting (mail.uifontsize pref) if set, otherwise the main window's computed font size. Returns 0 if neither is available.
